title: Schweinshaxe German-Style Roasted Pork Knuckle
description: A classic German dish featuring a crispy roasted pork knuckle smothered in a sweet and tangy glaze.

ingredients.name: Pork knuckle
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher for a pork knuckle.

instructions: Rinse the pork knuckle and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the pork knuckle with salt and black pepper.
Heat the skillet over high heat and sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork knuckle to a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the pork is roasting, mix together the brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, and charred American wood chips to make the glaze.
After 20 minutes, brush the glaze all over the pork knuckle and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
